title: Open Backlog 0.1 item front matter
description: The front matter of a capability, epic, feature, story, bug, spike or task file. Checks what one file can show; rules that span files (parents, unique IDs, folders) are for a validator. See spec/README.md.

id.description: The item's ID: epic 2, feature 2.3, story-level 2.3.4, capability C1. Text, not a number: 2.10 is not 2.1 [read-as-text].

title.description: A short name, on one line [fields].

parent.description: The ID of the item above: a feature for story-level items, an epic for features, a capability (optional) for epics.

rank.description: Order within a status folder, lowest first.

sprint.description: The name of a file in sprints/, such as 2026-S24.

estimate.description: The size of the work, in the backlog's unit.

assignee.description: A handle: lowercase letters, digits, -, _ and . [fields].

release.description: The release the item ships in, such as 0.1.0.

repo.description: A repository listed under repos: in config.yml, or a list of them [repo-listed].

children.description: Never listed: children are worked out [not-stored].

status.description: Never stored: the folder is the status [not-stored].

progress.description: Never stored: progress is worked out [not-stored].

additionalProperties.description: Fields of a backlog's own are allowed and kept by tools [keep-unknown], but hold no email address [no-email].
